name: TRUNK-CASTER
description: INTERCOM: TRUNK-CASTER — the intercom trunking system on the bus (PLUGIN.TRUNK_CASTER and PLUGIN.TRUNK_SIM, the trunk contract): its Globe, Relay, Simulator, Cross Points, Usage, Space, Racks, Users and Analyzer, every Stream Deck panel and every protocol's frame simulator, each also a window of its own in the Intercom menu; the Ward-Beck MicroCOM II intercom it trunks (matrix, panels, MicroCOM III, the MCOM.EXE emulator); and the bare metal machines it runs on, alive or dead off the bus.
